resources.string: Source selection decides how the first stream is picked. Choose Manual to pick it yourself. During playback, DAN+ can try a compatible source if the current one fails or cannot start. If several sources stall, test the network and try a lighter version of the title.

These images show where you will land as you seek. DAN+ uses Seekr when configured and a matching image is available, then falls back to built-in previews. If playback starts slowly on your device, leave thumbnail preparation off or disable thumbnails.
Use this report if menus are slow or look clipped. It shows the interface size, scale and how long frames take to draw. For pauses during playback, use Device assessment in Advanced settings.

Buffer is video loaded ahead of time. Increase it only if playback pauses to load and the device has memory to spare. For a starting point, use Device assessment in Advanced settings. If the app freezes or closes during playback, try a smaller buffer or a lighter source.

Fast start: choose this if your connection is steady and the title plays smoothly.

Balanced: start here for everyday viewing or when the test has too little data.

Stall resistant: try this if the network varies and playback often pauses to load. It prepares more video and may take longer to start. DAN+ caps the buffer for your device. If pauses continue, try a lower-bitrate source.

Choose a profile, then use Apply. You can undo the change on this screen.
Suggested for this test: Stall resistant. The connection varied during the test.
Suggested for this test: Balanced. The connection stayed steady during the test.
The test collected too little data to recommend a profile. If you want to try one, start with Balanced. To keep your current settings, leave without applying.
